raw:
Giancarlo Fisichella's 2004 teammate at Sauber was **Felipe Massa**.

The 2004 Sauber line-up appears in the race reports from several rounds (Malaysia, San Marino, Spain, Monaco, Europe, Hungary, Japan and Brazil), with Massa and Fisichella as the two Sauber finishers. The season standings support this: Sauber's 34 constructor points equal Fisichella's 22 plus Massa's 12, so no other Sauber driver scored that year. I did not retrieve every 2004 race report, so I have not verified that Massa started all 18 rounds, but no other Sauber driver appeared in the results I found.

ANSWER: Felipe Massa
